name: ad_ad_groups_write
_type_note: R158.56c-d (2026-10-09) — type=command 是 on-demand 包, 8 个 group_* commandType 共用本包 (PS1 内 switch 8 case). 故意不设 agent.intervalSec — PackageManager.reschedule 见到 type=command 直接 continue. 解 R158.56c-d user_create FormatException 教训的姊妹分支, ship via syncFromCenter 不动 agent bundle 版本.
description: R158.56c-d (2026-10-09) — AD group write-action dispatcher package. collect.ps1 接受 -CommandType <group_search|group_create|group_set_attributes|group_add_member|group_remove_member|group_set_members|group_delete|group_list_members> -ParamsPath <jsonfile>, PS1 内 switch-case 路由到 Get/New/Set-ADGroup / Add/Remove-ADGroupMember / Get-ADGroupMember. 替代静态 agent/scripts/ad-admin-groups.ps1, 通过 syncFromCenter 推到 33 DC.
